name: Air Times
overview: Localised series air times from TheTVDB
description: Air Times is a plugin for Jellyfin that localises series air times provided by TheTVDB to your servers timezone. Must be above the original TheTVDB plugin in the metadata sources list.

versions.changelog:
- Support Jellyfin 12.4 (.NET 10, Jellyfin.Controller/Model 12.4.0).
- Fix skyhook.sonarr.tv requests failing with 400 Bad Request by sending a User-Agent.
- Fix air times being an hour off across DST changes by converting each air date on its own date.
- Fix scheduled task trigger type for newer Jellyfin versions.

- Add an hourly task to fix recently added episode PremiereDates when metadata refreshes set them after the item added date.
- Change the full-library PremiereDate fix task to manual-only.
- New scheduled task to periodically fix all PremiereDates.
- When new file is added it sometimes does not have an added date. This will now use the file creation date as a fallback.

- Fix exception in logs
- Do not allow future release date (max always today)

- Fix exception in logs
- Do not allow future release date (max always today)

- Support for localised individual episode air times
- Rename metadata source to "TheTVDB (Air Times)"

Initial release
- Support for localised series air times
